Gideon's July 1 update in #strategic-pod gave **280 seats** for Vantorre Group. I posted that answer in the channel as a reply to your message.

He first posted 300, which included sandbox logins from the May rollout. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280, the active seat count on the production roster as of Jul 1. Use 280 for the roster sheet.
